proposition: The dissertation describes the verse on MS Majlis 10196 f. 121b two ways, as nine Persian and three Arabic ghazals, four Persian rubāʿīs, a qiṭʿa and two muʿammās (p.87) and as eight ghazals, eight rubāʿīs and two Arabic fragments (pp.87-88); the contents of the page cannot be settled from these pages.
